requirement.preferredDesignStyle: Warm Modern Minimal with Teak Accents and a Coastal-Calm Palette
requirement.materialsBrandsPreferences: Italian Botticino marble in the great room, engineered oak in bedrooms, Burma teak for the gazebo pergola, Jaquar and Kohler sanitaryware, Legrand Arteor switch plates.
requirement.civilRequirements: Developer shell to be made good; no structural changes. All wet areas to be re-waterproofed and ponding-tested before tiling.

requirement.siteAccessConstraints: Community gate allows material entry 09:00-18:00 only; no heavy vehicle movement on Sundays. Lift not available - first floor material moved via staircase.
